Prompt 7 builds the psychological intelligence layer — the systems that make Torgima understand WHY users succeed or fail, not just THAT they did. This includes: the Psychology Agent (fully activated), identity continuity engine that tracks who the user is becoming, character progression system tied to real execution, outcome validation that detects false progress, multi-hypothesis failure classification, burnout detection engine, pattern learning that stores behavioral insights, and the reward system that creates intrinsic motivation through execution milestones. When Prompt 7 is complete, Bhudhi knows the user as a human, not just as an executor.

Burnout detection scores INFORM — they do not automatically change conditions or task counts. A HIGH burnout risk score is passed to the Condition Agent and Control Engine as context. They decide what to enforce.

False progress detection flags outcomes for review — it does not automatically mark tasks incomplete or roll back signals. It raises an adversarial score that increases proof requirements on future tasks.
Reward events are generated by the system based on real execution evidence. Bhudhi drafts the reward language. The reward record is written by the system engine, not by Bhudhi directly.
